articles.title: Array completes sale of select spectrum assets to AT&T for $1.018 billion
articles.mainIdea: Array completes sale of select spectrum assets to AT&T for $1.018 billion
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Array completes sale of select spectrum assets to AT&T for $1.018 billion. Array Digital Infrastructure, Inc.SM (NYSE: AD) (ArraySM) today announced the successful closing of the previously announced agreement with AT&T (NYSE: T) to sell a portion of the Company's retained spectrum licenses for total consideration of $1.018 billion. Related tickers mentioned: AD, T-PA, TMUS.
